feature: Register evaluator-guard.sh and chain-evaluator.sh in hooks.json
problem: Two hooks exist in .cursor/hooks/ but are absent from hooks.json: evaluator-guard.sh (blocks evaluator source writes) and chain-evaluator.sh (auto-advances build phase). Without registration, the evaluator has no write protection and phase auto-advance is dead code.
proposed_solution: Add one entry to preToolUse[] for evaluator-guard.sh (matcher: Write) and one entry to subagentStop[] for chain-evaluator.sh (new event key). No logic changes to the scripts themselves.
acceptance_criteria: hooks.json contains a 'subagentStop' key at the top level of 'hooks' with chain-evaluator.sh as its sole entry
hooks.json preToolUse[] contains evaluator-guard.sh with matcher 'Write' — appears after contract-gate.sh so contract-gate runs first
The JSON in hooks.json is valid (python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open(".cursor/hooks.json"))' exits 0)
All previously registered hooks are still present and unmodified in hooks.json
make eval-fast exits 0 with no new failures
edge_cases: chain-evaluator.sh uses 'subagentStop' not 'stop' — wrong event key would silently not fire; evaluator verifies the key matches the hook's own header comment
evaluator-guard.sh order in preToolUse[] matters: contract-gate must run before evaluator-guard to avoid false denials
verification_method: python3 -c 'import json; h=json.load(open(".cursor/hooks.json"))["hooks"]; assert "subagentStop" in h; assert any("chain-evaluator" in e["command"] for e in h["subagentStop"]); pt=h["preToolUse"]; assert any("evaluator-guard" in e["command"] for e in pt); assert pt.index(next(e for e in pt if "evaluator-guard" in e["command"])) > pt.index(next(e for e in pt if "contract-gate" in e["command"])); print("PASS")' && make eval-fast
